adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now selects the target calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and then unconditionally falls back to `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`. If `destinationCalendar` is present but none of its entries has a matching `credentialId` (e.g., entries missing `credentialId` or mismatch), the event will be inserted into the user's primary calendar with no error/warning, which is the “wrong calendar” behavior described. The diff shows no guard/throw in this case—just the silent fallback.
